meta.phase: Phase 0 — Positioning, Landscape Sweep & Competitive Deep Dive

evidence_grading.1: Primary — government publications, official statistics, official pricing pages, statutes, our own interviews/pilot data
evidence_grading.2: High-quality secondary — IIM/IIIT research, established consulting, World Bank/OECD, peer-reviewed
evidence_grading.3: Market intelligence — Tracxn, Crunchbase, Factly/Dataful, SaaS directories (G2, Capterra, GetApp)
evidence_grading.4: Community — vendor blogs, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, review-site excerpts

reliability_markers.VERIFIED: read directly from a primary source
reliability_markers.NOT_PUBLIC: gated behind login or sales call
reliability_markers.UNVERIFIED: could not be confirmed; do not cite externally

records.name: NestLens Orbit
records.price_note: Launch Rs 75,000 / Starter Rs 99,000 / Growth Rs 1,25,000 / Scale Rs 2,50,000 per year
records.strengths: Genuinely India-native (INR, named schemes NIDHI/DST-TBI/BIRAC/RKVY-RAFTAR, Sarvam AI transcription). Transparent published pricing at a sane institutional price point. Publishes prices at all, which is rarer than it sounds. Deep adjacent products (NestHR campus-placement OS, Sentinel).
records.weaknesses: Brand new (2025), unproven in institutional procurement. No reference customer a university committee could name. Contradictory pricing on its own domain (Rs 75k tiers vs 'Orbit OS Rs 29,999/month'). No third-party reviews. 25,000-application ceiling on the Rs 75k tier may not suit a large IIC.
records.complaints: None findable. No G2, Capterra, GetApp, Reddit or Product Hunt presence.
records.does_not_do: No IPR or patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No office/lab/facility booking. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA submission flow. No on-premise or data-residency option stated.
records.threat_level: CRITICAL - closest existing competitor, sets the price anchor

records.name: EcoSync
records.price_note: NOT PUBLIC - pricing page is client-side rendered and returns no figures. Free tier for individuals (founders, mentors, investors, students).
records.strengths: Most complete Indian operational localisation of any vendor (INR default, GST and TDS per transaction, UPI payouts, Asia/Kolkata scheduling, Razorpay Route). Deep funding traceability (source -> programme -> tranche with over-allocation blocked at entry) and facility management nobody else does. Real audit trails. Module-level granularity without tier upgrade. Public documentation. Has already publicly conceded no SOC 2 / ISO 27001 and no uptime SLA.
records.weaknesses: One customer. Small Indian team. No security certification, no SLA. Pricing entirely opaque pre-signup - a real friction point against an Indian purchase committee. AI not meaningfully present. No reference scale.
records.complaints: None findable. No G2, Capterra, GetApp, Reddit or Product Hunt presence.
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent/trademark/copyright tracking. No TRL modelling. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA/NIRF integration. No curriculum/LMS. No AI evaluation or screening. No mobile app. No equity/cap-table. No SOC 2/ISO 27001 (stated). No public uptime SLA (stated).
records.threat_level: HIGH - best operational localisation, but disqualified by enterprise procurement today

records.name: Incubatee (SCIP)
records.price_note: Rs 25,000/month + Rs 75,000 one-time + Rs 10,000 mobile app + Rs 850/admin/month = Rs 3,95,200 year one
records.strengths: Only India competitor publishing complete INR line items. Transparent two-model choice (SaaS only, or SaaS plus managed back-office). Deepest incubation process methodology of any vendor. Bundled tool suite that removes SaaS sprawl: SCIPpoint (scheduling), HiLegally (contract drafting), FoldersFiles, SCIPsign (e-sign), SCIPnews. Mentors and startups are NOT billed as users. Founder was COO of Dubai SME and created Dubai's government incubator and seed-investing programme (2005-2013).
records.weaknesses: Rs 3.95L year one is 3-5x Orbit. Page body says 'Pay as you use' contradicting the fixed table. Website content appears auto-generated with grammatical errors. No customers named. No GST/TDS/UPI despite being an Indian vendor. Product-name confusion with a separate SCIP investment product.
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA integration. No GST/TDS, no UPI, no Indian payment rails. No AI. No office/desk/cabin rent. No white-label. No investor data room or cap-table. No demo-day management.
records.threat_level: HIGH - sets the Indian price ceiling; proves services-model viability

records.name: IncubatX
records.price_note: Foundation Rs 10,000-15,000/mo; Accelerator Rs 30,000-40,000/mo; Executive AI Rs 50,000-60,000/mo; Media Kit Rs 15,000/mo
records.strengths: Cheapest credible INR entry point (Rs 10k/month = Rs 1.2L/yr). The only vendor publishing a government-scheme directory with named schemes and amounts (240+ schemes: DPIIT SISF up to Rs 20L, SIDBI CGTMSE Rs 2 Cr, MeitY TIDE 2.0 Rs 15L, DST NIDHI Prayas Rs 10L). Strongest AI framing. WhatsApp and Razorpay integrations that matter operationally in India.
records.weaknesses: Founded 2026, zero verifiable customers, zero reviews, prices given as ranges not fixed figures. Heavy AI superlatives with a placeholder-flavoured live dashboard showing demo data ('Cohort 2025-A', '142 received', 'Graduates 38'). 'SOC 2-ready' is not SOC 2. Paid Media Kit add-on and event-access bundling suggest a services business wearing a SaaS label.
records.complaints: None findable. No review-site presence. Given 2026 founding, there is no independent evidence base.
records.does_not_do: No real IPR/patent tracking despite an 'IP' tile on the impact dashboard. No TRL grading. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA integration. No office/facility booking. No white-label. No faculty/student-side product. No cap-table. No documented API. No SOC 2 certificate.
records.threat_level: HIGH - most directly contradicts the todo.md V1 hypothesis, but substance is thin

records.name: Accubate
records.price_note: NOT PUBLIC on own site (four tiers each showing only 'Book a Meeting'; the page renders the header 'Pricing' followed by 'Book a Meeting', an obvious bug). Capterra/GetApp starting $149/month. GetApp lists both free trial and free version.
records.indian_customer_names: NSRCEL (IIT Bombay); NASSCOM; TCS; Hero MotoCorp; NCL; KPMG; Accenture
records.strengths: Best Indian enterprise credibility of any player (TCS, KPMG, Accenture, Hero MotoCorp, NSRCEL, NASSCOM). Longest-tenured India player with real scale (12,000+ startups, 35,000+ ideas self-reported). White-label at Premium. Multi-site/multi-incubation-centre at Enterprise - directly relevant to universities with several campuses. 26 verified reviews - the only real evidence base in the market. Verified Hero MotoCorp Government Administration deployment (daily use, 2+ years).
records.weaknesses: Pricing opaque on its own site (an actual bug - no price shown). Dual identity: it is a spinoff of a conference-management company and the solutions menu is heavily weighted to conferences, summits and hackathons rather than incubation. Feature list has an unresolved template bug. Documentation gap - the one verifiable complaint. No AI.
records.complaints: Rajender B., Incubation Lead (Capterra, 4 Sept 2024, 4.0 overall, Features 3.0): Cons - 'No User manual!!' | Capterra AI summary: 'some users say the many options can feel confusing at first and suggest clearer menus, better feature visibility, and tutorials.'
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA integration. No AI application screening or predictive scoring. No named Indian government schemes, no GST/TDS, no UPI depth. No curriculum/LMS. No office/facility booking. No documented API. No Hindi UI despite listing Hindi.
records.threat_level: HIGH - the credibility benchmark and the only real Indian reference base

records.name: AcceleratorApp
records.price_note: Core from $499/month (~Rs 5,988/yr, ~Rs 5.4L/yr), no setup fee, migration included. Funding module published: Essential $549/mo, Professional $899/mo, Funding seats +$49/mo each.
records.strengths: Category leader by institutional credibility. ISO 27001 certified, GDPR compliant. Best academic logo list in the market: Start It @KBC, SparkLabs, CGIAR, Max Planck Innovation, Yale, German Accelerator, MBC Africa, MIT Design X, Imagine H2O, Pomona Impact Foundation. Independently confirmed customer: MassChallenge. Only major vendor with a published grant/funding module including capital-call management and disbursement tranches. Data residency for regulated funders. Public pricing on the Funding module. Migration included.
records.weaknesses: Most expensive and least transparent for the core product - sales-gated. Turkish/European/LatAm customer base, no India presence, no INR, no Indian schemes, no GST/TDS/UPI. Multilingual list includes English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Ukrainian - but NOT Hindi. Very small team. SSO, audit logs, API and data residency are Enterprise-only.
records.complaints: No G2/Capterra profile found. Independent analyst (Innoloft, 6 Oct 2026): 'Events detail - Ticketing and on-site check in specifics are limited. Depth of LMS should be validated before adopting.'
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No Indian regulatory stack (GST, TDS, UPI, Razorpay, DPIIT, NIRF, IIC, YUKTI). No real office/facility/desk management. No mobile-native app.
records.threat_level: MEDIUM-HIGH - sets the Rs 5.4L ceiling and could pivot if it ships an India module

records.name: Gohorto
records.price_note: NOT PUBLIC - pricing page is a JavaScript application returning no figures. Claims free trial, no credit card required. GetApp lists $399/month (third-party, unconfirmed).
records.strengths: Ambitious and genuinely broad module coverage including a PMO module, AI application screening, evaluation, investment tracking. Free trial, no card. Named real customers (Mustafa Sakizli, General Manager, BINA Business Incubator, Turkey; Burak Vergi, Ostim Teknik Universitesi). Extensive public documentation.
records.weaknesses: Zero verifiable scale behind very large claims. Claims 'G2 High Performer 2026 in Project Management' on only 3 GetApp reviews, one flagged vendor-referred. Self-authored comparison pages score Gohorto 4.8 and every rival 2.1-3.6. Timeline implausible: 20,000 startups and 200+ programs by 2022, on a platform launched 2019 with Product Hunt debut Nov 2025 and 697 LinkedIn followers. Content heavily LLM-generated (truncated sentences, orphaned fragments, broken testimonials). No public pricing.
records.complaints: SaaSHub reviewer: 'While I'd like to see more customizable reporting options down the line.' (incentivised-directory review, treat as directional)
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No Indian regulatory stack whatsoever. No facility booking. No white-label. No mobile app (despite one review claiming otherwise). No cap-table. No verifiable AI model or documentation.
records.threat_level: LOW-MEDIUM - credibility problems undermine its enterprise claims

records.name: Founderhood
records.price_note: Free (1 admin, 15 startups/program, unlimited programs); Starter $199/mo; Premium $649/mo; Advanced custom. Universities AND nonprofits eligible for a 15% discount.
records.strengths: Best-published pricing in the category. Genuinely strong free tier - 15 startups/program with unlimited programs and unlimited applications. Explicit 15% UNIVERSITY discount - the only vendor actively courting Indian institutional buyers on price. Named enterprise customer (Deloitte). Alumni management is a real Premium differentiator. Zoom integration for live sessions. Case study: European Startup Universe Cyprus - '300% increase in Startup Universes' startup portfolio, from a year ago'.
records.weaknesses: Only 1 G2 and 2 Capterra reviews - effectively no independent evidence base. 'Coming soon' markers on Teams and Zapier integrations on paid tiers. Greek/EU-centric, no Indian localisation, no GST/INR-by-default, no Indian schemes. Both listed customers are EU programmes. HQ country inconsistent across sources (Athens per Crunchbase, London per G2).
records.complaints: Aglaia O., Small-Business (G2, 3 May 2023, 4/5): Dislikes - 'It was a bit difficult to register the consultants and the teams.' | Capterra AI summary flags: 'does not offer Video Conferencing' (contradicted by the G2 review praising videocalls - treat Capterra categorisation as unreliable)
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA/NIRF/DPIIT integration. No Indian payments/GST/TDS or INR-default. No weighted panel evaluation rubric as a first-class feature. No office/lab/facility/desk booking. No grant-source -> tranche ledger. No cap-table. No AI. White-label limited to 'program branding (logo and brand colours)' at Premium.
records.threat_level: MEDIUM - the credible global price objection at ~Rs 1.4L/yr university-discounted

records.name: VentureLink
records.price_note: Lite free forever (1 programme, 100 applications, 5 mentors); Core $180/mo or $1,730/yr + $500 setup. Add-ons: emails $25-60/mo, jobs $15, courses $20-50, events $30.
records.strengths: 'No per-user fees. No hidden feature gating.' - a genuine and rare structural advantage for institutions with large founder/mentor populations. Best price transparency after Founderhood. Cheap Core tier. Real white-label-adjacent customisation. Named university customer quote: Ignacio Mongrell, Assistant Director, ICUBE, University of Toronto - 'We ran the incubator on bunch of disconnected tools, multiple spreadsheets, and a lot of emails. VentureLink replaced all of it... how much time came back to the team!' (vendor-published, T4).
records.weaknesses: Appears extremely early-stage - 2 employees on LinkedIn, no customers, no reviews, no screenshots, LinkedIn page with 18 followers. Brand confusion is a real liability: four different businesses share the name VentureLink (venturelink.com, venturelink.app, ventureuplink.com). SaaS Browser categorises it under 'Venture Capital and Private Equity' - wrong category positioning. Marketing content thin and template-generated.
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA/NIRF/DPIIT integration. No Indian localisation (no INR default, GST, TDS, UPI, Razorpay). No office/real-estate management (room reservation only). No grants/CSR ledger. No weighted evaluation rubric or panel audit trail. No AI. No mobile app. No true white-label. No documented API.
records.threat_level: LOW-MEDIUM - correct pricing philosophy, negligible scale

records.name: incuTrack
records.price_note: Starter $75/mo, Premier $250/mo when paid quarterly; $595 one-time setup incl. 6-month training. Add-ons: Mentor Matching $30/mo + $90 setup, Work Orders $25, Invoicing $50, Surveys $20, Events $50, Visitor/Lobby $75. Guided Configuration $150 optional. NBIA member pricing.
records.reviews: 10 G2 (3.8) - recent ones calling it 'quite outdated'
records.strengths: Category's most mature product by age (copyright Cybergroup Inc. 2002) and physical-operations depth. The ONLY vendor doing key control, work orders, lease and insurance tracking, visitor/lobby management - and it supports kitchen incubators explicitly. Cheapest credible tier ($75/mo). Most granular transparent pricing. NBIA partner of seven years with special member pricing. Economic-impact data collection for funders. 30+ payment gateways. Video conferencing and scheduling integrated.
records.weaknesses: Strongly US-association-driven - no India market at all. Recent G2 reviews call it 'quite outdated' and 'lacking innovation'. Dashboard analytics and customisation criticised. Support team 'not always available to customize and provide assistance'. Mentorship is a paid add-on rather than core.
records.complaints: 'incuTrack is quite outdated and it is evident that the company is not pouring resources into it, there has been little change in the past few years; it lacks innovation' (G2, 25 Apr 2023, 4/5) | 'The performance dashboard is promoted as a tool it lacks analytics and customization options limiting its accuracy... incuTrack is still a tool that is not able to benefits incubation projects. It is too much time consuming.' (G2, 22 Dec 2023, 3/5) | 'The drawback is that there are reports and the support team is not always available to customize and provide assistance.' | G2 AI summary: 'some mention that the user interface feels outdated and could benefit from improvements'
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No IIC/YUKTI-NIR/ARIIA integration. No Indian localisation or payment rails. No AI. No white-label.
records.threat_level: LOW for us (US-only) - but 20 years in with real US adoption and still weak at analytics is the key lesson

records.name: RiserNest
records.price_model: EUR per team OR per user
records.price_note: Model A per team/mo: EUR 399 / 799 / 1,500 for 30 / 30-100 / 100+ teams. Model B per user/yr: EUR 40 / 70 / 120 per user/month. Free trial, self-serve.
records.white_label: Strong (own domain + own native mobile apps)
records.strengths: Strongest white-label in the category - own dashboard, own community app AND native mobile apps (Google Play + App Store confirmed), own domain. 'Your community never sees RiserNest, they see you.' Best-documented real-scale deployment in the market: Frank and the Backs (real Brussels nonprofit) - 428 founders, 220+ startups, 62 mentors, matching and tracking in one system. Free trial, no card. Honest case study. Document version control. Founder mood tracking.
records.weaknesses: Two contradictory pricing models on one page, one claiming 'No per-seat pricing'. EUR-only, no India presence. No AI, no grants/funding ledger, no IPR, no evaluation-panel depth, no Indian compliance. Community-first bias - weaker on institutional reporting and audit trails than EcoSync/AcceleratorApp.
records.does_not_do: No IPR/patent tracking. No TRL modelling. No Indian regulatory stack (INR/GST/TDS/UPI). No funding tranche ledger. No weighted evaluation rubric / panel audit trail. No AI. No curriculum/LMS. No document-heavy application workflow at AcceleratorApp depth.

records.name: Innoloft / LoftOS
records.price_note: Free (5 users); Starter $29/mo (25 users); Team $349/mo (250 users, custom domain); Professional $849/mo (1,000 users, analytics, exports); Enterprise (5,000 users, full white-label)
records.strengths: THE DIY THREAT - a no-code portal builder WITH an accelerator program template. Free templates for Accelerator, Incubator, Fellowship, Tech Transfer, Corporate Venture, Grant Program. A university with an IT team could build its own incubation portal for $29-349/month and own it outright. University case study: RWTH Aachen University (Collaeb) - 'created Collaeb as a central hub for entrepreneurship... unifies mentors, researchers, students, and partners in one space.' Publicly admits: 'We do not hold' no such certification; self-declared weaknesses are honest.
records.weaknesses: Requires build effort. Self-admitted: 'Large grant disbursement flows may require a dedicated finance tool.' 'Versatile feature set may involve a short learning curve for first time admins.' Pricing figures come from Innoloft's own blog - a vendor-authored listicle ranking itself #1 of 8.
records.complaints: Positive only: 'we can build our own modules and programmes and now even our own category trees' | 'If there is any bug, the team is fast to repair it.'
records.does_not_do: Out of the box: IPR tracking, TRL, Indian compliance, panel evaluation rubric depth, AI, grant disbursement ledger (self-admitted), advanced LMS. Requires build effort.
records.threat_level: HIGH - the under-rated threat; kills any 'we have more features' moat

records.name: Elsevier Pure
records.price_note: Public UK G-Cloud 14 list: Core Module GBP 19,406/yr (Tier 1, 1-999 researchers) to GBP 58,504/yr (Tier 5). Reporting GBP 6,805; Portal GBP 6,805; CV GBP 2,452; Award Management GBP 11,149; Assessment GBP 5,444. Setup GBP 13,500 one-off (MANDATORY); Management service startup GBP 18,750 one-off (MANDATORY); each integration/import GBP 5,188.
records.strengths: 500+ institutions, 50+ countries. Research Information Management System: publications, funding, people, projects, impact. Syncs with Scopus, ORCID, Web of Science. Vendor buy-vs-build claim: 'Pure provides 70% added value over DIY and costs at least 41% less than DIY systems.'
records.weaknesses: Minimum realistic Indian university deployment (Core + Portal + Reporting) = GBP 33,016/yr (~Rs 44.6L/yr) plus GBP 32,250 one-off (~Rs 43.5L). A mid-size institution with Award Management is nearer Rs 60L+/yr. Elsevier has since moved to 'Contact us' pricing.
records.does_not_do: Does not manage startups, cohorts, mentors or incubation. Manages research outputs and grants only.
records.threat_level: LOW as a competitor / HIGH as a procurement objection ('we already own Pure')

records.name: IdeaScale
records.price_note: Engage USD 12,999; Evolve USD 21,999; Advance USD 34,999; Transform USD 64,999 - all TWO-YEAR subscriptions, no free plan. Vendor now says 'custom subscriptions'.
records.strengths: 4.5M+ participants across government, education and regulated enterprises. Public price list (rare in this category). Crowdsourced idea campaigns, voting, evaluation.
records.weaknesses: ~$6,500/yr entry tier = ~Rs 5.85L/yr. Corporate intrapreneurial - assumes an HR-grade employee base, an SSO directory and an IT department. Not a university/incubator fit.
records.does_not_do: No IPR, no TRL, no mentorship workflow, no incubation cohorts, no Indian compliance.
records.threat_level: LOW - wrong category, wrong price ceiling

records.name: Incu (Sweden)
records.price_note: 790 kr/user/month (~US$75) + EUR 3,500 implementation. Described as 'Moduler med nyckeldata om avtal, patent, kapital, varumarke'
records.strengths: THE ONLY VENDOR FOUND ANYWHERE WITH EXPLICIT PATENT AWARENESS. Also TRL/maturity levels. The only vendor stating it will import existing data during onboarding (Cases, Ideas, Persons) - which is the #1 blocker to an Indian institutional sale.
records.weaknesses: A data field, not a workflow. Swedish. No Indian market presence. Small.
records.does_not_do: No IPR workflow (docket, deadlines, renewals). No incubation ops. No Indian compliance.
records.threat_level: LOW now, but the one to watch for IPR capability - see OQ-18
